description: JavaScript code implementing the client-side logic for the 'blame_incremental' view in gitweb, including DOM manipulation, AJAX request handling, blame data parsing, and UI updates.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Represents a blamed commit with SHA1 and related metadata.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Constructor for Commit objects, initializes SHA1 and parent count.

methods.name: countLines
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in the blame table or returns '...'.

methods.name: updateProgressInfo
methods.description: Updates the progress display and progress bar width based on blamed lines.

methods.name: writeTimeInterval
methods.description: Displays the time taken to generate blame data and script execution.

methods.name: errorInfo
methods.description: Displays an error message in the progress info area.

methods.name: getColorNo
methods.description: Extracts color number from a table row class name.

methods.name: chooseColorNoFrom
methods.description: Selects the least used color number from given options.

methods.name: findColorNo
methods.description: Determines a color number different from neighboring rows for blame table coloring.

methods.name: isStartOfGroup
methods.description: Checks if a table row is the start of a blame group.

methods.name: fixColorsAndGroups
methods.description: Optimizes blame table row coloring by merging groups and applying zebra striping.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Updates DOM rows with blame commit info, coloring, and links.

methods.name: processBlameLines
methods.description: Parses lines from blame data and updates commit objects and DOM accordingly.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes unprocessed blame data, splitting into lines and parsing.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles AJAX errors, displays message, and clears memory.

methods.name: responseLoaded
methods.description: Finalizes blame data processing after AJAX completes.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles AJAX response states, processes data, and manages timers.

methods.name: startBlame
methods.description: Initiates blame data retrieval via AJAX and sets up incremental updates.
